contracts: CardModel.CurrentUpgradeLevel cannot exceed MaxUpgradeLevel; Wither MaxUpgradeLevel is zero and its separate fake upgrade count affects its damage.
Physical card identity, singular enchantment and affliction slots, ordered local energy and temporary star costs are carried independently of current effective costs.
Source expiry Combat=0,Turn=2,Played=4 translates to simulator saved Combat=4,Turn=2,Played=1.
Glass raw passive accumulator differs from Focus-modified displayed passive/evoke values. Dark retains its evoke accumulator.
Finished card history distinguishes auto plays and replay indices; only non-auto play index zero counts manual cards.
Live attack intent labels contain per-hit damage; simulator MonsterState.intent_damage stores total damage with hit_count separately.
Necrobinder Osty exists independently of whether it is currently alive; explicit zero HP is preserved.
